stocks.discussion_driver: Workday reported Q3 FY27 results on Nov 24, beating EPS ($2.82 vs $2.75 est.) and revenue ($2.705B vs $2.69B est.), with AI ARR surging 130% YoY to nearly $150M in new ACV. However, cautious near-term guidance implying a slight deceleration from Q3's pace disappointed investors, sending shares down approximately 7% after hours despite the headline beat.
bull_case: AI products generated nearly $150M in new ACV — more than triple year-ago levels — demonstrating Workday's successful transition to AI-powered enterprise software and creating a durable new growth engine
Strong customer retention, 11.2% revenue growth, and subscription revenue guidance of $9.96B (+13% YoY) for FY2027 underpin a durable recurring-revenue model with limited customer churn risk
bear_case: Post-earnings guidance flagged renewal tailwinds fading and near-term deceleration, with billings missing estimates at $2.57B — a leading indicator that could weigh on future revenue growth

Morgan Stanley holds a Sell rating with $180 target near current price; Barclays trimmed its target, reflecting concern that the premium valuation (36x trailing P/E) is not justified by slowing growth

stocks.discussion_driver: Nutanix reported Q1 FY27 on Nov 24, with EPS beat ($0.60 vs $0.49 est.) but revenue of $772.4M slightly below expectations; CEO Rajiv Ramaswami simultaneously announced plans to step down once a successor is named. The dual negative — disappointing FY2027 outlook plus leadership uncertainty — sent shares down 5% in the regular session and another 7-8% after hours, compounding cloud infrastructure spending concerns.
bull_case: Zacks upgraded NTNX to Strong Buy on Nov 19 and Needham maintains a Buy; at 11x trailing P/E with 15.9% revenue growth, the stock trades at a significant discount relative to peers in the cloud infrastructure space
EPS beat of $0.60 vs $0.49 expected demonstrates improving profitability and operating leverage even as top-line growth moderates, suggesting margin expansion optionality
bear_case: CEO departure creates material leadership uncertainty at a critical juncture; losing Rajiv Ramaswami — who rebuilt Nutanix's subscription pivot — during a period of enterprise IT spending headwinds amplifies execution risk
FY2027 outlook missed analyst expectations, signaling that enterprise cloud infrastructure spending is under pressure; at 27% below its 52-week high and declining, negative price momentum may persist

stocks.discussion_driver: AMD fell approximately 7-9% on Nov 24 as the AI chip sector gave back part of Monday's historic gains that followed Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO. AMD's selloff was part of a broader chip rout — with Micron and CoreWeave also declining sharply — as markets digested whether Monday's euphoric 31% NVDA surge represented genuine AI spend acceleration or a one-day sentiment spike.
bull_case: AMD trades ~37% below its 52-week high with a consensus analyst price target of $598+ implying 45%+ upside; Goldman Sachs maintains Buy at $675 reflecting confidence in AMD's data center GPU roadmap and MI300X competitive positioning

Forward P/E of approximately 24x (vs trailing 88x) reflects rapid earnings growth expectations; AMD's AI accelerator revenue is ramping and the company is a primary beneficiary of enterprise efforts to diversify away from NVDA supply dependency
bear_case: Trailing P/E of 88x is extremely elevated; any guidance miss or slowdown in data center GPU orders could trigger a sharp multiple compression, as evidenced by this week's violent price swings
Nvidia's Blackwell GPU ramp and intensifying competition from custom ASICs (Google TPUs, Amazon Trainium) may limit AMD's market share gains in the AI accelerator market

stocks.discussion_driver: Micron dropped 11% on Nov 24 as a BNP Paribas analyst downgraded the stock to Neutral from Outperform with a $775 target, citing cyclical memory downturn risk and reduced NAND orders from Chinese cloud providers. The selloff came on top of an already-turbulent week — MU fell 13.9% on Nov 20 during the broader chip sector rout, then rebounded 19% on Nov 23, only to give back gains again the following session.
bull_case: At just 8.5x trailing P/E — one of the cheapest valuations in semiconductors — with analyst consensus targets averaging $1,412 (124% upside), Micron's AI-driven HBM memory demand thesis is not reflected in the current price

High-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI training is a structurally growing market, and Micron is one of only three producers globally; the company is gaining share from Samsung and SK Hynix in HBM3E as AI infrastructure spending remains robust
bear_case: BNP Paribas downgrade cites a nascent cyclical memory downturn with reduced NAND orders from Chinese cloud customers; memory markets are historically highly cyclical and can enter prolonged oversupply periods
The stock has lost nearly 50% from its 52-week high of $1,255, with no stabilization in sight; continued macro uncertainty and trade policy risks affecting China revenues could suppress recovery

stocks.discussion_driver: Amentum surged approximately 20% on Nov 24 after Q4 FY2026 earnings beat analyst estimates, with the company simultaneously announcing its first-ever $500M share repurchase program — a signal of management's confidence in cash generation. As a defense/government services contractor, AMTM was a rare standout gainer during a session that saw chip stocks and enterprise software fall sharply.
bull_case: First-ever $500M buyback authorization (significant vs ~$6B market cap) signals strong FCF generation and management confidence; in a volatile tape, capital return programs provide a floor for the stock and attract value-oriented investors

Defense and government services spending remains resilient and sticky across administrations, with long-term contracts providing revenue visibility; AMTM operates across nuclear, environmental, and intelligence sectors with limited commodity exposure
bear_case: JPMorgan lowered its price target to $26 (Neutral) from $31 and Goldman Sachs cut to $24 — both below or near the current post-earnings price, suggesting limited near-term upside is priced in by institutional analysts

Federal budget sequestration risk and potential DOGE-driven government contract reviews could disrupt Amentum's pipeline; with 6 of 9 analysts at Hold, consensus reflects limited conviction in meaningful outperformance
